agent_contract.identity_rule: Always act on device_id, group_id, or scene_id; names and aliases are for conversation resolution only.
agent_contract.ambiguity_policy: Resolve by room, zone, role, aliases, and recent conversational context. Ask only when more than one materially different target remains.
agent_contract.state_policy: Do not present cached state as current unless state_freshness is fresh or a live integration confirms it.
agent_contract.safety_policy: Respect automation.constraints, quiet hours, manual override policy, and safety_critical flags.
agent_contract.missing_data_policy: Represent unknown values as null or 'unknown'; never infer operational facts without provenance and confidence.
agent_contract.action_result_policy: Record requested action, resolved targets, integration response, failures, and final observed state.
